headline: The 910A FP16 encoder is at least as faithful to the FP16 reference as a 4090 running the official HF code; the earlier 4.39% gap is inherent FP16 cross-implementation scatter, not an NPU defect. Original BF16 is numerically unreachable from FP16 and is not a valid FP16 acceptance target.
user_directives_honoured: Precision work moved to owned RTX 4090; slow CPU baselines stopped.

Weights were NOT downloaded to the operator workstation and NOT relayed through it: they were fetched machine-to-machine on the GPU host from the already-verified official checkpoint on the leased NPU host.
GPU BF16 reference reads the ORIGINAL official BF16 tensors; no FP16->BF16 round trip was ever constructed.
910A still runs FP16 only; no BF16 requirement was imposed on the 910A.
No distilled model, no fake norm, no hidden conditioning cache, no clamp, no tolerance waiver was used.

interpretation: The FP16 path of this model is numerically ill-conditioned: three independent FP16 executions scatter by 4.4-7.3% RMS on the visual rows while the text rows agree to 0.035-0.15%.

The original BF16 result is 85-92% away from every FP16 execution, i.e. 12-20x further than the FP16 implementations are from each other. Aligning FP16 to BF16 is therefore not achievable and was explicitly excluded by the user.

Because the 910A is closer to the CPU FP16 reference than the 4090 running the official HF code is, the previously reported 4.39% gap cannot be attributed to a 910A implementation defect; it is the expected scatter of FP16 on this graph.
The practically relevant conditioning rows are the 27 text rows; there the 910A agrees with the CPU FP16 reference to 0.035% and with the 4090 FP16 reference to 0.15%.

not_claimed: No end-to-end video-quality equivalence between the FP16 and BF16 pipelines is claimed.
No 910A latency or throughput claim is derived from the GPU wall times; those are reference-construction timings only.

The overall goal (AscendC/TBE fusion kernels, flash-attention efficiency, VAE decode and text-encode latency inside the 768p/5s/fl2va/USP8 envelope, and an official-comparable A2/A3 measurement) remains incomplete.
next: Establish whether the 85-92% visual-row divergence is materially inert in generation: confirm from the DiT conditioning path whether visual-token rows are excluded from the text conditioning mask, and if they are not, quantify the generated-video impact.

Return to the performance track: the fused RMSNorm/AddRMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE and AdaLN kernels, the flash-attention efficiency work at N=63232, and the VAE decode 155s->20s / text encode 39s->2s targets on 910A.
Release any remaining leases once GPU and NPU work is concluded.
